version.approval_notes: MIT-licensed open-source Comizy chapter downloader, submitted for unlisted self-distribution. Source archive includes release/BUILD.md with exact build instructions and release/REVIEWER_NOTES.md with permission explanations and test steps. The stable add-on ID predates the comizy-dl rename. No developer backend or telemetry. Direct page/image requests and normal Comizy-tab traffic are disclosed in PRIVACY.md. The manifest declares browsingActivity and websiteContent for those requests.
